name: Drypoint
description: Drypoint: lines that thicken steadily across the plate, the way the needle digs in as it goes.
svgExportNote: The stripe mask can sit up to a pixel away from the on-screen rendering, and its internal coordinates use calc(), which some design tools don't evaluate.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 2); y: -1; width: calc(2 + @n(-1) * 1.8); height: 102; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; rect*6 { x: calc(@n(-1) * 16.6 + 2); y: -1; width: calc(2 + @n(-1) * 1.8); height: 102; fill: #000 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
